'''Breathmask survival gear''' was a type of equipment used by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] for survival in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. It consisted of a backpack extension with breathing tubes that connected to their [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II helmets']] breath filters. Similar equipment was later used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] early [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]].
